quests.hint: Stress 'NOT TRY-ing TO A-LARM' gently, then 'SHOULD PROB-a-bly' with genuine concern.
quests.explanation: This hedge softens a worrying suggestion, said gently before the more direct advice that follows.
quests.textToSpeak: I'm not trying to alarm you, but you should probably get that checked.

quests.hint: Stress 'TO BE HON-est' as a confiding opener, then the phrasal verb 'PUT-ting OFF.'
quests.explanation: This honesty hedge introduces a personal admission, often said with a slightly sheepish, lighter tone.
quests.textToSpeak: To be honest, I've been putting off this appointment for weeks.

quests.hint: Stress the idiom 'BE-LIEVE IT OR NOT' with genuine surprise in your tone.
quests.explanation: This idiom introducing a surprising fact is said with rising energy to convey authentic enthusiasm.
quests.textToSpeak: Believe it or not, a short walk can do wonders for your mood.

quests.hint: Stress 'DON'T TAKE THIS THE WRONG WAY' gently, almost playfully.
quests.explanation: This idiom softening a potentially touchy comment is said with a light, affectionate tone rather than a serious one.
quests.textToSpeak: Don't take this the wrong way, but you sound just like your mother.

quests.hint: Stress the idiom 'FOR BET-ter OR WORSE' evenly, then 'STUB-born-ness' with gentle humor.
quests.explanation: This idiom accepting mixed inheritance is balanced evenly in stress, often delivered with warm, self-aware humor.
quests.textToSpeak: For better or worse, we've inherited a lot of his stubbornness.

quests.hint: Stress 'AT THE RISK OF SOUND-ing SEN-ti-MEN-tal' to soften the emotional admission.
quests.explanation: This hedge anticipates how a sincere comment might be perceived, said gently before the heartfelt statement itself.
quests.textToSpeak: At the risk of sounding sentimental, this house holds our whole story.

quests.hint: Stress 'I'LL AD-MIT' as a genuine concession, then 'AS MUCH AS I DID' with real enthusiasm.
quests.explanation: This hedge introduces a pleasant surprise, and the enthusiasm comes through in the rising energy of the final phrase.
quests.textToSpeak: I'll admit, I didn't expect to enjoy it as much as I did.

quests.hint: Stress the idiom 'SAY WHAT YOU WILL' to acknowledge possible disagreement.
quests.explanation: This idiom invites disagreement on one point while firmly asserting another, stressed to balance both halves fairly.
quests.textToSpeak: Say what you will about the ending, but the performances were outstanding.

quests.hint: Stress the idiom 'IF AN-y-thing' lightly, then 'E-VEN BET-ter' enthusiastically.
quests.explanation: This idiom introducing an even stronger claim is said with rising enthusiasm on the comparative that follows.
quests.textToSpeak: If anything, the sequel was even better than the original.

quests.hint: Stress 'NO OF-fense' gently to soften a blunt observation.
quests.explanation: This idiom preemptively softens a potentially sensitive comment, said with a caring rather than critical tone.
quests.textToSpeak: No offense, but you really don't look like yourself today.

quests.hint: Stress 'WELL-BE-ing' warmly to show genuine priority.
quests.explanation: This familiar idiom for final priorities is followed here by a sincere, caring statement, stressed with warmth.
quests.textToSpeak: At the end of the day, your wellbeing matters more than the deadline.

quests.hint: Stress the idiom 'MARK MY WORDS' confidently to predict an outcome.
quests.explanation: This idiom asserting confident prediction is stressed firmly at the start, setting up the reassurance that follows.
quests.textToSpeak: Mark my words, you'll feel completely different after a good night's sleep.

quests.hint: Stress the idiom 'LIKE IT OR NOT' to acknowledge an unavoidable truth.
quests.explanation: This idiom accepting an inevitable reality is stressed evenly, often delivered with a knowing, slightly resigned tone.
quests.textToSpeak: Like it or not, family gatherings always bring out strong emotions.

quests.hint: Stress the idiom 'TO MAKE A LONG STO-ry SHORT' quickly as one connected phrase.
quests.explanation: This idiom for summarizing a longer story is said quickly, almost like a single compound expression.
quests.textToSpeak: To make a long story short, we ended up staying the whole week.

quests.hint: Stress the idiom 'BLOOD IS THICK-er THAN WA-ter' as one traditional, well-known phrase.
quests.explanation: This well-known idiom about family loyalty follows a fixed, traditional rhythm that hasn't changed across generations.
quests.textToSpeak: Say what you want, but blood is thicker than water.

quests.hint: Notice the very informal 'gonna' here, fitting for casual conversation about entertainment.
quests.explanation: In relaxed, informal speech, 'going to' almost always reduces to 'gonna,' especially in casual idioms like this one.
quests.textToSpeak: Not gonna lie, that twist completely caught me off guard.

quests.hint: Stress the idiom 'FOR WHAT IT'S WORTH' lightly before the firmer opinion that follows.
quests.explanation: As practiced earlier, this hedge softens an opinion before a more direct, confidently stressed statement.
quests.textToSpeak: For what it's worth, critics don't always get it right.

quests.hint: Stress the idiom 'AT FIRST GLANCE' lightly, then 'SUR-PRISED ME' with genuine warmth.
quests.explanation: This idiom introducing a first impression sets up a contrast, stressed against the more positive realization that follows.
quests.textToSpeak: At first glance, it seemed like just another sequel, but it surprised me.

quests.hint: Stress the idiom 'LONG STO-ry SHORT' quickly, then 'COM-PLETE-ly NOR-mal' with relief.
quests.explanation: This summarizing idiom is followed here by genuine relief, conveyed through a warmer, more relaxed tone on 'normal.'
quests.textToSpeak: Long story short, the test results came back completely normal.

quests.hint: Stress 'I'VE BEEN BET-ter' with quiet honesty, then 'GET-ting THERE' with quiet hope.
quests.explanation: This honest, understated admission balances a difficult truth with a hopeful note, both delivered gently.
quests.textToSpeak: If I'm honest, I've been better, but I'm getting there.

quests.hint: Stress the idiom 'ALL THINGS CON-SID-ered' to introduce a balanced, positive conclusion.
quests.explanation: This idiom for weighing everything together leads naturally into good news, said with genuine warmth.
quests.textToSpeak: All things considered, the recovery has gone better than anyone expected.

quests.hint: Stress 'I DON'T MEAN TO PRY' gently and carefully.
quests.explanation: This hedge softens a personal question, said carefully to show genuine concern rather than nosiness.
quests.textToSpeak: I don't mean to pry, but is everything okay between you two?

quests.hint: Stress the idiom 'WITH ALL DUE RE-SPECT' to soften a respectful disagreement.
quests.explanation: This idiom signals polite disagreement, stressed evenly to convey genuine respect alongside the differing opinion.
quests.textToSpeak: With all due respect, I think Grandma has a point this time.

quests.hint: Stress 'FAM-i-ly' and 'MAT-ters MOST' warmly to close with sincerity.
quests.explanation: This familiar idiom for final priorities closes here on a warm, sincere note, stressed to convey genuine feeling.
quests.textToSpeak: At the end of the day, we're family, and that's what matters most.

quests.hint: Stress the idiom 'ON THE FENCE' evenly to convey genuine uncertainty.
quests.explanation: This idiom describing indecision is stressed evenly across both words, mirroring the balanced uncertainty it describes.
quests.textToSpeak: Honestly, I was on the fence about this show until the third episode.

quests.hint: Stress 'BE-TWEEN US' quietly, then 'O-VER-BLOWN' with gentle skepticism.
quests.explanation: This confiding idiom is said quietly, setting up a skeptical opinion delivered with a slightly dry, knowing tone.
quests.textToSpeak: Between us, I think the hype around this one is a bit overblown.

quests.hint: Stress 'JUST A MOV-ie' lightly, then 'MOVED ME' with genuine emotion.
quests.explanation: This sentence contrasts a casual dismissal with real feeling, and the shift in tone carries that emotional turn.
quests.textToSpeak: At the end of the day, it's just a movie, but it moved me more than I expected.

quests.hint: Stress the idiom 'SAY WHAT YOU WILL' to acknowledge doubt, then 'PAYS OFF' confidently.
quests.explanation: This wraps up the Advanced+ level by acknowledging possible skepticism before asserting a confident, motivating truth.
quests.textToSpeak: Say what you will, but consistent practice always pays off in the end.

quests.hint: Stress the idiom 'IF NOTH-ing ELSE' modestly, then 'A LOT MORE' with real pride.
quests.explanation: This idiom finds genuine value in progress, said with modest understatement followed by real, warranted pride.
quests.textToSpeak: If nothing else, you've learned to sound a lot more like a native speaker.

quests.hint: Stress 'WHEN ALL IS SAID AND DONE' to close reflectively, then 'ONE HON-est con-ver-SA-tion' warmly.
quests.explanation: This closing idiom reflects on the whole journey, ending the level with a sincere, encouraging final thought.
quests.textToSpeak: When all is said and done, fluency is built one honest conversation at a time.
